notes.title: Naughty Girl Update
Hentai Waifu Update
Hentai Waifu II: Big Update + New Game
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34689984/a46a4432f51be6b21adaec8554e68d7f471b6529.jpg[/img]


Hi boys, now it's time to update Hentai Waifu II, here is a list of everything we done:

[list][*] New pieces movement algorithm - For a more fluid gameplay
[*] The game and music fade in when opened
[*] Save if the music was muted on the last gameplay
[*] The musics are now stereo and have a better quality
[*] Vsync now activated in 60 fps to avoid super fast gameplay
[*] New background for every girl, with more pleasing look
[*] New Trailer and screenshots[/list]

Also, check our brand new game [b]Hentai Waifu II[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085640/Hentai_Waifu_II

Thanks for all the love, if you enjoyed our games, please review it to help make it reach a bigger audience. 

Check our other games on STEAM

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1091950/Naughty_Girl/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1044450/Hentai_Waifu/

notes.title: Hentai Waifu: Big Update + New Game
notes.notes:
Hello boys, we have a big new update for [b]Hentai Waifu[/b] to show you
[list]
[*] New pieces movement algorithm - For a more fluid gameplay
[*] The game and music fade in when opened
[*] Save if the music was muted on the last gameplay
[*] The musics are now stereo and have a better quality
[*] Vsync now activated in 60 fps to avoid super fast gameplay
[*] Girl 2 and Girl 9 now has different color set (game and image pack)
[*] New background for every girl, with more pleasing look
[*] New Trailer and screenshots
[/list]
We also have a brand new game to share with you, it's scheduled to be released in september 2nd!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1137730/Naughty_Girl_2/
Thanks and as aways - RELAX.

Check our other games on STEAM
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1085640/Hentai_Waifu_II/
